title: Ripple — yesterday's fix, today's evidence
narration_disclosure: Locally synthesized narration; no participant voice imitation.

chapters.label: RIPPLE / GRAPH HACKS 2026
chapters.title: Yesterday’s fix. Today’s failure.
chapters.text: Yesterday's fix can break today's system. Ripple is an evidence-driven incident recovery agent: it follows connected evidence, challenges an outdated recommendation, and verifies what actually works.

chapters.label: 01 / CONNECTED CONTEXT
chapters.title: The graph is the decision system.
chapters.text: This is the latest Ripple interface, replaying actual Gemini output against FalkorDB Cloud. Six synthetic services connect dependencies, owners, deployments, source records, and action constraints. The paths shown here came from FalkorDB.

chapters.label: 02 / THE FAMILIAR FIX
chapters.title: A plausible rollback. An expiring assumption.
chapters.text: Checkout failures follow a payments release. An earlier compatibility record permits rollback, and the agent initially proposes it. The timeline preserves that recommendation and the evidence available at the time.

chapters.label: 03 / EVIDENCE CHANGED
chapters.title: New evidence invalidates old approval.
chapters.text: Then a ledger migration changes the facts. The old deployment is incompatible with the current schema. Ripple marks the earlier proposal stale, and the actual sequence driver confirms that its approval cannot execute.

chapters.label: 04 / TRACE THE CONSTRAINT
chapters.title: Block the rollback. Permit a scoped change.
chapters.text: The original migration source blocks rollback while permitting a feature flag change. Source provenance makes this constraint inspectable. The replacement recommendation must cite retrieved evidence.

chapters.label: 05 / VERIFY THE OUTCOME
chapters.title: Three failing services. Three passing probes.
chapters.text: The agent recommends disabling strict currency validation. Deterministic code rechecks the revision and executes the approved simulator action. Checkout, payments, and storefront each change from HTTP 503 to 200. Only then is recovery verified.

chapters.label: 06 / MEMORY WITHOUT CHAT HISTORY
chapters.title: A new conversation. A measured memory.
chapters.text: A fresh investigation retrieves and explicitly cites the previous model-selected, probe-verified recovery from FalkorDB. Earlier chat messages are not carried over. Current constraints still have to match before that memory can justify another action.

chapters.label: 07 / KNOW WHEN TO STOP
chapters.title: Missing evidence means no execution.
chapters.text: In the third scenario, the available records do not justify a supported remediation. Ripple identifies the missing diagnostics and executes nothing. Failed and uncertain outcomes remain visible; they are never stored as successful procedures.

chapters.label: 08 / ACTUAL HOSTED EXECUTION
chapters.title: Gemini + FalkorDB Cloud + Render.
chapters.text: A separate hosted HTTP test verified recovery with one Gemini call and a 7.014-second investigation. Duplicate approval returned the same result, memory survived scenario reload, and another visitor received a 404. The raw receipt is public.

chapters.label: 09 / MEASURED COMPARISON
chapters.title: Publish the results. Keep the limits.
chapters.text: In a separate CPU-model benchmark, graph mode met twelve of twelve expected outcomes; full-document context met eleven. Graph mode was slower and missed complete impact twice. All twenty-four records, including failures, are published. This is not a Gemini comparison.

chapters.label: 10 / REPRODUCIBLE PROOF
chapters.title: Strong evidence. Honest boundaries.
chapters.text: Three consecutive CPU sequences passed. One complete native Gemini sequence passed; three consecutive native sequences remain unverified, and the free quota is exhausted. These are synthetic incidents. The approved demo database connection is plaintext. No production systems are connected.

chapters.label: AGENTS THAT ACT ON CONNECTED DATA
chapters.title: Follow the evidence. Prove the recovery.
chapters.text: Ripple makes the decision inspectable, the action guarded, and the outcome measurable. Explore the latest console, inspect the public proof, and reproduce the project from its source. Built with AI assistance, with locally synthesized narration.
